types.description: TeSys LADN22 front-mounted instantaneous auxiliary contact block, 2 NO + 2 NC, screw clamps

document.title: TeSys D, SK, K, SKGC, GC, GY, GF Contactors — Chapter B8
document.pages: B8/22 selection and B8/79 diagram (physical PDF pages 22 and 79)

modelingNotes: Source LAD-N22 is interpreted as presentation-separated manufacturer LADN22: exact B8/22 front-mounted 2NO + 2NC screw-clamp selection matches the historical description. Requested catalog spelling is retained; no suffix or successor is substituted.

B8/79 LADN22 diagram 127273.eps visually establishes NO 53-54 and 83-84, NC 61-62 and 71-72, with common mechanical actuation. NO/NC annotations are represented by function state; numeric keys preserve terminal numbers.
Four ganged passive contacts; no fixed electrical links. Normally closed paths are switched, not permanent joins. Host contactor coil, main poles and any other accessories are outside this block.
Contact use is application-dependent; no terminal is universally required. Screw clamps permit two conductors under the documented size/ferrule conditions, hence shared connection policy.

LADN22 product sheet dated 2026-09-11 pp.1-2: AC-15 6 A at 120 V and 1.04 A at 690 V; DC-13 0.55 A at 125 V and 0.1 A at 600 V; Ith 10 A at 60 C. Ue 690 V AC 25-400 Hz; Ui 690 V IEC, 600 V UL/CSA. Minimum switching 17 V and 5 mA. Capabilities remain notes, with no assigned nominal voltage, AC-only restriction or scalar switching-current rating.
Product sheet: https://www.se.com/us/en/product/download-pdf/LADN22. Screw torque 1.7 N m; conductor capacities and historical specimen limitation are recorded in research.md.

connectionCoverage.notes: All eight screw-clamp contact terminals of the LADN22 auxiliary block are represented. No coil, main power poles, PE/bond, supply, shield or communications interface is present in the documented block. Host contactor connections are outside this separate accessory.
